title: CORDIC Square Root HDL Optimized
text: CORDIC-based approximation of square root, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Automatically select CORDIC maximum shift value based on input word length}, {CORDIC maximum shift value} sets the maximum shift value of hyperbolic vectoring and {Number of iterations per pipeline register} sets the number of CORDIC iterations to perform in pipeline. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: u
ports.summary: Value to take square root of non-negative real-valued scalar

ports.name: validIn
ports.summary: Whether input is valid Boolean scalar

ports.name: restart
ports.summary: Whether to clear internal registers Boolean

ports.name: y
ports.summary: CORDIC-based approximation of square root of input real-valued scalar

ports.name: validOut
ports.summary: Whether output data is valid Boolean

params.name: Automatically select CORDIC maximum shift value based on input word length
params.values: Automatically select CORDIC maximum shift value based on input word length on (default) | off

params.name: CORDIC maximum shift value
params.values: Maximum shift value of hyperbolic vectoring CORDIC 10 (default) | positive integer-valued scalar

params.name: Number of iterations per pipeline register
params.values: Number of CORDIC iterations to perform in pipeline stage 1 (default) | positive integer-valued scalar
